pages.text: A $(item)Meteor Chart$() marks where something will fall. Be there, and mine what lands.
Raw meteorite is beaten into ingots around an $(item)Ancient Arrowhead$().
Ingots upgrade netherite blades, tools and armour at a smithing table, with a $(item)Meteorite Tablet$() as the template.
Copy a tablet with an $(item)Ancient Arrowhead$() and a $(item)Meteorite Ingot$().
